description_en: Invokes the AddBgpNetwork operation to advertise a Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) network
kebab_example: aliyun vpc add-bgp-network --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dst-cidr-block 10.10.XX.XX/32 --router-id vrt-2zeo3xzyf38r4u000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddBgpNetwork

parameters.help_en:
The region where the VBR group resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VBR组所在的地域。

 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block of the VPC or vSwitch that needs to be interconnected with the on-premises data center
parameters.help_zh: 需要和本地IDC互连的VPC或交换机的网段。
parameters.name: dst_cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vRouter associated with the router interface
parameters.help_zh: 路由器接口关联的路由器ID
parameters.name: router_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
